title.en: Ampère's circuital law and the solenoid

hook.en: Gauss's law made symmetric electric problems easy. Ampère's circuital law does the same for magnetism: walk once round a closed loop, and the field along it tells you the current inside.
hook.kn: ಗಾಸ್ ನಿಯಮ ಸಮಮಿತ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸುಲಭಗೊಳಿಸಿತು. ಆಂಪಿಯರ್‌ನ ಆವರ್ತ ನಿಯಮ ಕಾಂತತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಅದೇ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: State Ampère's circuital law and use it for a long straight wire.
Find the field inside a long solenoid.

narration.en: Gauss's law made symmetric electric problems easy. Ampère's circuital law does the same for magnetism: walk once round a closed loop, and the field along it tells you the current inside.
narration.kn: ಗಾಸ್ ನಿಯಮ ಸಮಮಿತ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸುಲಭಗೊಳಿಸಿತು. ಆಂಪಿಯರ್‌ನ ಆವರ್ತ ನಿಯಮ ಕಾಂತತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಅದೇ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: The line integral of B around any closed loop equals μ₀ times the current threading the loop: $\oint\vec B\cdot d\vec l = \mu_0 I_{enc}$. For a long straight wire, take a circle of radius r: $B\cdot2\pi r = \mu_0I$, so $B = \mu_0I/2\pi r$. The field lines are concentric circles around the wire; the right-hand thumb rule gives their sense.
body.kn: ಆಂಪಿಯರ್ ನಿಯಮ: ∮B·dl = μ₀I_ಒಳಗೆ. ಉದ್ದ ನೇರ ತಂತಿಗೆ B = μ₀I/2πr; ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ತಂತಿಯ ಸುತ್ತ ಏಕಕೇಂದ್ರೀಯ ವೃತ್ತಗಳು.

narration.en: Ampère's law says the sum of B along a closed loop equals mu nought times the current inside. For a long straight wire this gives B equals mu nought I by 2 pi r, in circles around the wire.
narration.kn: ಆಂಪಿಯರ್ ನಿಯಮ: ∮B·dl = μ₀I_ಒಳಗೆ. ಉದ್ದ ನೇರ ತಂತಿಗೆ B = μ₀I/2πr; ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ತಂತಿಯ ಸುತ್ತ ಏಕಕೇಂದ್ರೀಯ ವೃತ್ತಗಳು.

blocks.formula: \oint \vec B\cdot d\vec l = \mu_0 I_{enc},\qquad B_{wire} = \frac{\mu_0 I}{2\pi r}

body.en: A long solenoid with n turns per unit length carrying current I has a uniform field inside, along its axis: $B = \mu_0nI$. Outside, the field is nearly zero. At the ends the field is about half the value at the middle. A soft-iron core greatly increases B.
body.kn: ಉದ್ದ ಸೊಲೆನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ನ ಒಳಗೆ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಏಕರೂಪ: B = μ₀nI (n = ಪ್ರತಿ ಮೀಟರ್‌ಗೆ ಸುತ್ತುಗಳು). ಹೊರಗೆ ಬಹುತೇಕ ಶೂನ್ಯ.

narration.en: Inside a long solenoid the field is uniform and equal to mu nought n I, where n is turns per metre. Outside it is almost zero.
narration.kn: ಉದ್ದ ಸೊಲೆನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ನ ಒಳಗೆ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಏಕರೂಪ: B = μ₀nI (n = ಪ್ರತಿ ಮೀಟರ್‌ಗೆ ಸುತ್ತುಗಳು). ಹೊರಗೆ ಬಹುತೇಕ ಶೂನ್ಯ.

problem.en: A long straight wire carries 5 A. Find the magnetic field 10 cm from it.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A long straight wire carries 5 A. Find the magnetic field 10 cm from it.

problem.en: A solenoid 0.5 m long has 500 turns and carries 5 A. Find the field inside it.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A solenoid 0.5 m long has 500 turns and carries 5 A. Find the field inside it.

body.en: Since μ₀/4π = 10⁻⁷, the field of a long wire is B = 2 × 10⁻⁷ I/r, and the force per metre between two wires is 2 × 10⁻⁷ I₁I₂/d. No π to carry around.

narration.en: The 2 × 10⁻⁷ shortcut. Since μ₀/4π = 10⁻⁷, the field of a long wire is B = 2 × 10⁻⁷ I/r, and the force per metre between two wires is 2 × 10⁻⁷ I₁I₂/d. No π to carry around.
Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two competitive exam pattern questions. Read carefully, then choose.

points.en: Solenoid: B = μ₀nI inside, nearly zero outside.
points.kn: ಸೊಲೆನಾಯ್ಡ್: ಒಳಗೆ B = μ₀nI, ಹೊರಗೆ ಬಹುತೇಕ ಶೂನ್ಯ.

homework.en: A solenoid of length 0.4 m with 2000 turns carries 2 A. Find the field inside it.

narration.en: Recap. Ampère: ∮B · dl = μ₀I_enc. Long wire: B = μ₀I/2πr = 2 × 10⁻⁷ I/r. Solenoid: B = μ₀nI inside, nearly zero outside.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಆಂಪಿಯರ್: ∮B · dl = μ₀I_ಒಳಗೆ. ಉದ್ದ ತಂತಿ: B = μ₀I/2πr = 2 × 10⁻⁷ I/r. ಸೊಲೆನಾಯ್ಡ್: ಒಳಗೆ B = μ₀nI, ಹೊರಗೆ ಬಹುತೇಕ ಶೂನ್ಯ.
